opening.argument: The presentation ties ClubCoin to spending, discounted purchases, a stated minimum value, and recurring issuance for holders who stake their coins. It says, “For every $1 you spend with Big Club Network, you'll will automatically receive one Club Coin,” offers members the opportunity to purchase more coins at a discount, and claims that one coin “will be worth a minimum of $0.05 and can be easily exchanged through our platform or another one.” It further says that “the more coins you hold and stake in your wallet the more coins will be issued every five minutes.” Alongside the $3,599 membership example presented as 3,599 free coins, these claims connect continued spending or participation with promised digital-asset benefits, while fulfillment of the stated value, exchange access, issuance, and purchase availability remains unestablished.
